theme: Light mode default. Soft, airy, high-utility, productivity-app aesthetic.

typography.headings: Outfit (Clean, modern geometric, un-opinionated but distinct character)
typography.body: Figtree (Highly readable for data density and tables)
typography.weights: Light (300) for large numbers, Medium (500) for standard headings, Bold (700) for highlights
typography.tracking: tracking-tight on H1/H2, normal on body

colors.primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white (For check-in and primary actions)
colors.destructive: bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white (For check-out, leave rejection)

visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle ambient shadows for cards: shadow-[0_2px_10px_-3px_rgba(6,81,237,0.05)]
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements (buttons, inputs)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for mobile bottom navigation and sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80)

layouts.desktop: Left sidebar (w-64) with minimal icons + text (bg-white, border-r). Main content area fills remaining space with bg-[#F8F9FA]. Top nav for Breadcrumbs and Notification bell.
layouts.mobile: Bottom navigation bar (fixed, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl). Main content has pb-24 to avoid overlap. Sidebar is hidden.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento style. 4 stat numbers at top (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4). Main table spanning col-span-full or 2/3 width.
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal scrolling container. Columns are w-80, bg-slate-50/50, border border-slate-100, rounded-2xl, p-4. Cards are bg-white, rounded-xl, shadow-sm, p-3.

components.check_in_button: Massive circular or large pill-shaped button on Dashboard/Mobile home. If checked in, turns to 'Check Out' with red tint. Include a live pulsing dot and a timer (00:00:00) using monospace font (font-mono).
components.status_badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium). Soft backgrounds with dark text (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 for 'Present', bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 for 'Pending').
components.tables: Minimalist. No vertical borders. border-b on rows. Generous padding (py-4 px-4). Hover state on rows (hover:bg-slate-50/80).
components.payslip: Clean, grid-based layout. Two columns for Earnings vs Deductions. Prominent 'Download PDF' button.
components.trello_card: Minimalist task card. Title (text-sm font-medium), due date badge, assignee avatar (size-6 rounded-full), priority indicator (colored dot).
components.sidebar_links: Subtle hover states (hover:bg-slate-100). Active state gets a soft bg and primary color text.

motion.timer: Pulsing opacity on a small green/red dot next to the live timer.
motion.drag_drop: Card scales down slightly (scale-95) and shadow increases when dragging.
motion.page_transition: Simple fade-in (opacity-0 to opacity-100 over 200ms) for tab/page switching.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Text over light backgrounds must be slate-700 or slate-900.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit' for H1-H4 and 'Figtree' for body.
Prioritize a clean, white/light-gray layout. Avoid dark mode styling; stick to the light mode aesthetic for this productivity app.
Implement the Kanban board using @hello-pangea/dnd. Keep it robust, prevent horizontal scroll on the main page layout, keep scroll contained within the Kanban area.
The Attendance Check-In button must be massively prominent on the Dashboard and Mobile Home screen. It's the primary daily action.
For Mobile layout, completely hide the side navigation and implement a fixed bottom navigation bar with 5 icons: Home, Attendance, Tasks, Leave, Profile.
Use Shadcn UI components but modify them: strip away heavy borders, make them look softer (rounded-xl/2xl, minimal light shadows).
DO NOT overcomplicate the UI. The problem statement emphasizes 'very few buttons, minimal icons'. Every screen must immediately answer 'What do I need to do now?'. Use ample whitespace.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
Ensure 'date-fns' is used to run the live timer for attendance.
Implement Payslip with a clean table and a functional PDF download.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep shadows minimal and elegant.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) strictly for the mobile bottom nav and sticky headers.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements (opacity, transform, background-color).
DO NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) for breathing room. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Rely exclusively on lucide-react.
